args.title: Make error toasts assertive and persist until dismissed
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update the toast live region aria-live from "polite" to "assertive" for error toasts specifically to ensure immediate announcement by screen readers. Also, prevent error toasts from auto-dismissing after five seconds, requiring manual dismissal instead.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue relates to accessibility of error toasts which currently use a polite live region and auto-dismiss after five seconds. The responsible file is src/components/Toast.tsx which manages the toast UI. The fix would be to make error toasts assertive and persistent until manually dismissed, improving accessibility for screen reader users.
